args.hypothesis: pc-guest default route points to non-existent gateway 10.10.2.77 instead of 10.10.2.1, breaking all guest outbound traffic
args.evidence_for: show_routes on pc-guest shows default via 10.10.2.77; r-edge is 10.10.2.1; traceroute shows no first hop; all guest flows fail

commands: ip route replace default via 10.10.2.1 dev eth0
plan.rationale: Restore guest connectivity to webserver while maintaining security policy; ticket request to allow guest->staff 8080 is denied per policy
plan.expected_effect: pc-guest can reach webserver tcp/80, still cannot reach staff
rollback: ip route replace default via 10.10.2.77 dev eth0

root_cause.summary: default route via 10.10.2.77 invalid, should be r-edge 10.10.2.1
